summary: Bound |𝓘_j| by the integral of the modulus, then by formConst_mul_lintegral_le with t = max(1, ρ²⁴|y|), or trivially when some head product is large.

steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨_, _, hp, hq, Z⟩, c, _, _, _, ⟨_, N⟩, K, k⟩ := hF.exists_gauge_isHead j p q (𝔰.n ^ 6),
    hF.isCut_complexLevel, hF.ten_le, y.norm_pos, hF.two_le_b,
    exists_add_of_le hF.ten_pow_le_varrho, exists_add_of_le hF.pow_seven_le_k
steps.claim: Take L and the heads from exists_gauge_isHead with K = (ϱ+1)⁶ (bound Z); F is cut (c); ρ ≥ 4; |y| > 0; b ≥ 2; ϱ = 10⁸ + N and k = (ϱ+1)⁷ + K'.

steps.lean: obtain z | Z := not_or_of_imp (Z (ρ ^ (9 * 𝔰.n)) (by bound))
steps.claim: Either some head product exceeds R = ρ^{9(ϱ+1)} (z), or all are bounded by R and Z applies.

steps.lean:
have := (formMajorant_sq_le _ c c.1 hj hp (x := ·) ⟨⟩ (σ := 0) (by tauto) le_top
    c.isNear_of_ne_zero fun _ _ _ u v ↦ z.elim fun l m ↦ ⟨minors_mem_ofSize hF.gauge.hasMatSize_box
    hj u (c.isNear_of_ne_zero (by aesop)).choose_spec l m, minors_mem_ofSize hF.gauge.hasMatSize_box
    hj v (c.isNear_of_ne_zero (by aesop)).choose_spec l m⟩)
steps.claim: In the first case formMajorant_sq_le with σ = 0 shows the majorant vanishes (a large head product forces the minors to be large, minors_mem_ofSize, so the support condition fails).
Hence formModulus = 0 there and the bound holds.

steps.lean:
grw [hF.formConst_mul_lintegral_le hj c.1 (by simp [hF.lintegral_sq_cut_le]) zero_le_one hp hq
    c.isNear_of_ne_zero le_sup_left (fun _ ↦ c.formModulus_le_formMajorant hω) fun m ↦ ?_,
    (?_ : _ * _ ≤ 𝔰.n ^ 6), Z, ← (?_ : 9900000 * 𝔰.n ^ 3 + (K + 6) ≤ s), hj, dampedPower, k,
    ← (by simp [field, t] : ρ ^ 24 / t ≤ _⁻¹), ← (by simp [field, t]; bound : t⁻¹ ≤ 1 ⊓ _)]
steps.claim: Apply formConst_mul_lintegral_le with W = F, ε = 1, this t and f = formModulus (≤ the majorant), the hypothesis h giving the self-norm bound; then insert Z, s ≥ 9900000(ϱ+1)³ + K + 6 and t⁻¹ ≤ min(1, …).

steps.lean:
gcongr 1; simp [field, pow_add, div_pow, hF.rho_eq]; ring_nf
  simp [mul_assoc, ← pow_add]; gcongr
steps.claim: Arithmetic of the powers of ρ = b^{6(ϱ+1)+2}.

steps.lean:
any_goals first | clear Z; delta headWeight dampedPower bandConst volU; positivity
                  | rw [hF.k_eq, Shape.n, N] at *; lia | bound
steps.claim: Positivity and the exponent comparisons (k, n, s).

steps.lean: grw [h _ hp, hF.volumeExponent_eq.ge.trans tsub_le_self, max_eq_right (by grind)]
steps.claim: The hypothesis h at the gauge: (c/md y)^{|ι|} ≤ the required factor, with volumeExponent = s.

  simp (disch := finiteness) [← ofReal_norm, ← toReal_le_toReal, div_pow, field]
  ring_nf; repeat bound [two_le_pi]
